name: DungeonSwap
rootCause: The DeFi project DND Token (DungeonSwap Token) on BSC has been utilized. The initial funds came from TornadoCash, and the attackers stole over 2,400 BNB (approximately $728,000) from Dungeonswap.

descriptions.text: The DeFi project DND Token (DungeonSwap Token) on BSC has been utilized. The initial funds came from TornadoCash, and the attackers stole over 2,400 BNB (approximately $728,000) from Dungeonswap.

DungeonSwap, a BNB Chain GameFi and yield platform, was reportedly exploited on 2023-02-27. Public incident records place the loss at approximately $728,000 and classify the event as an improper access control incident, but no public postmortem or verified exploit transaction set has been identified. Public incident trackers classify the DungeonSwap exploit as an improper access control incident on BNB Chain. The available evidence does not establish the vulnerable contract, the affected privileged function, whether credentials were compromised, or the exact exploit transaction sequence.
